title: Portfolio Prioritization Packet for Leadership Review — Q2 Outcomes & Ask Structure
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a concise leadership packet that crystallizes portfolio-level priorities, the top asks for Q2 investment, and the decision framework leaders will use during the leadership review. This packet should be usable as the single source of truth during the Exec Strategy Sync and subsequent board Q&A. The goal is to secure prioritization and a conditional commitment to dedicated capacity runway and headcount for the Top-3 initiatives.

Scope: 1) One-page TL;DR with asks and decision options (A/B/C). 2) Three initiative briefs (initiative summary, estimated impact on unit economics, required runway, key risks, gating criteria). 3) SLO/cost sensitivity annex (throughput vs. $/1M tokens tradeoffs). 4) Stakeholder decision matrix and acceptance criteria. 5) Packaged appendix with data sources: perf bench, console dashboards, and customer usage signals.

Why now: After recent runtime throughput gains and several enterprise Dedicated inquiries, leadership needs clarity on which investments (Dedicated capacity expansion, Optimize tooling for batching/caching, Private deployment polish for compliance customers) move the needle on 6–12 month revenue and margin targets.

Deliverables: - Leadership packet PDF (slides + one pager) - Appendix data bundle (benchmarks, cost models, experiment results) - Ask language with fallback options if budget constrained

Primary decisions requested at review: 1) Approve go/no-go for increasing Dedicated pool by 20% for H2 (conditional on commit thresholds). 2) Prioritize Optimize workstream to deliver quantization presets and batching recommendations in Cycle 43. 3) Greenlight a lightweight Private deployment security sprint (30d) to unblock two regulated prospects.
acceptance_criteria: Packet includes a single-page executive summary with three clear asks and binary decision options
Each initiative brief contains conservative impact estimates (latency, cost per 1M tokens, projected revenue/ARR uplift)
Appendix contains reproducible links to perf tests and console dashboards
Leadership selection of a prioritized list (ranked A/B/C) and tentative allocation ranges for each ask
stakeholders: Jasper Lin (Infra Eng Lead) - data/bench signoff

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Benchmarks may not generalize to enterprise request patterns. Mitigation: include sensitivity scenarios and a conservative throughput multiplier.
Risk: Budget contention with growth initiatives. Mitigation: propose tiered asks (A: full capacity + Optimize; B: partial capacity + Optimize lite; C: Optimize only) with clear ROI deltas.
Risk: Security gating delays Private deployment. Mitigation: request 30d sprint to reduce blocker surface and include fallback for hosted offering with contractual SVP clauses.
decision_options: Option A — Aggressive: Approve full Dedicated pool + Optimize priority. Expected cost delta: +18% monthly; projected ARR impact: +6% over 12 months.
Option B — Balanced: Approve Optimize priority and conditional Dedicated expansion if top 2 enterprise deals execute. Expected cost delta: +8%; ARR lift: +3%.
Option C — Conservative: Focus on Optimize only and postpone Dedicated expansion. Expected cost delta: +2%; ARR lift: +1.2%.
